# nemau_security_group_rule (Resource)

A security-group rule. Immutable: any change recreates it.

Imports as `<security_group_id>:<rule_id>`, since a rule is only readable through its group; `nemau network security-group rules <group-id>` lists the rule ids. Importing is how the two default egress rules of a group (`0.0.0.0/0` and `::/0`) come under Terraform management, to be kept or deleted.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nemau_security_group_rule" "https" {
  security_group_id = nemau_security_group.web.id
  direction         = "ingress"
  protocol          = "tcp"
  port_range_min    = 443
  port_range_max    = 443
  remote_ip_prefix  = "0.0.0.0/0"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `direction` (String) `ingress` or `egress`.
- `security_group_id` (String) Id of the security group the rule belongs to.

### Optional

- `port_range_max` (Number) Last port of the range, for `tcp` and `udp`.
- `port_range_min` (Number) First port of the range, for `tcp` and `udp`. Set it equal to `port_range_max` for a single port.
- `protocol` (String) `tcp`, `udp`, `icmp`. When omitted, the rule covers every protocol.
- `remote_ip_prefix` (String) Remote prefix, for example `0.0.0.0/0`: the source of ingress traffic, the destination of egress traffic.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Rule id.

## Import

```shell
# A rule imports as <security_group_id>:<rule_id>, because the API serves a
# rule only within its group. `nemau network security-group rules <group-id>`
# lists the rule ids.
terraform import nemau_security_group_rule.https 9b5d3e1f-2a7c-4f68-9d41-6e8a0c3b7f25:5c1a8e3d-7b4f-4a92-8e60-2d9f1b6c4a57
```
